issues.problem:
Unfixed from last pass: headline still three lines with stranded 'supply' and line 3 starting 'to Gundlav.' 20ch is wider than the 5fr column so it does nothing; the
then forces a third line.
issues.fix:
Keep the copy and the
after 'supply'. Cap display size so 19ch fits the column: h1{font-size:clamp(2.1rem,4vw,2.75rem)} (~44px; 19×44×0.62~520px vs ~514px 5fr). Optionally .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:minmax(22ch,5fr) 6fr}. Do not rely on max-width:20ch alone.

issues.problem: 'Chairman Binay Chandra Jha' breaks before the surname, leaving 'Jha' alone on the second line in the 5fr column at h2 38.4px and again at 24px on a 335px mobile measure.
issues.fix: Write Chandra Jha (or wrap Binay Chandra Jha in a span with white-space:nowrap). If it still overflows, insert the break after Chairman so line 2 is the full name, not the surname.

issues.problem: -0.01em is ~0.6px at 57.6px and fights the 112% stretch, so the display face looks padded rather than set.
